title: Actions related to transmission of UuMessageTransferSidelink message

entities.name: Uu message transfer procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by L2 U2N Relay UE to transfer messages between network and L2 U2N Remote UE via sidelink.

entities.name: UuMessageTransferSidelink message
entities.description: Sidelink message used by L2 U2N Relay UE to transfer network information to L2 U2N Remote UE.

entities.name: sl-PagingDelivery
entities.description: Information element included in UuMessageTransferSidelink when Paging message is received for the Remote UE.

entities.name: sl-SystemInformationDelivery
entities.description: Information element included in UuMessageTransferSidelink when System Information needs to be delivered to Remote UE.

entities.name: Paging message received for Remote UE
entities.description: Condition where L2 U2N Relay UE receives Paging message from network containing ue-Identity of connected L2 U2N Remote UE.

entities.name: SIBs requested by Remote UE
entities.description: Condition where L2 U2N Relay UE acquires SIBs requested by connected L2 U2N Remote UE as indicated in sl-Requested-SI-List.

entities.name: Updated SIB1 received
entities.description: Condition where L2 U2N Relay UE receives updated SIB1 and SIBs have been requested by connected L2 U2N Remote UE.

entities.name: Always forward SIB1 to Remote UE
entities.description: Behavior where L2 U2N Relay UE always forwards SIB1 to the L2 U2N Remote UE regardless of other conditions.

relations.description: Uu message transfer procedure involves transmission of UuMessageTransferSidelink message.
UuMessageTransferSidelink message includes sl-PagingDelivery IE when Paging message is received for Remote UE.
UuMessageTransferSidelink message includes sl-SystemInformationDelivery IE when System Information delivery conditions are met.
Receipt of Paging message for Remote UE triggers initiation of Uu message transfer procedure.
Acquisition of requested SIBs triggers initiation of Uu message transfer procedure.
Receipt of updated SIB1 triggers initiation of Uu message transfer procedure.
Receipt of Paging message for Remote UE requires inclusion of sl-PagingDelivery IE in the message.
Acquisition of requested SIBs requires inclusion of sl-SystemInformationDelivery IE in the message.
Receipt of updated SIB1 requires inclusion of sl-SystemInformationDelivery IE in the message.
Property that L2 U2N Relay UE always forwards SIB1 establishes requirement for sl-SystemInformationDelivery IE inclusion.
